visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing an orange t-shirt with a small graphic unboxes a package. He holds up a rectangular box for a 'Singer Mic Shower Head' with both hands, showing the vintage microphone graphic to the lens. The room is brightly lit with a large flat-screen TV and a speaker in the background. (2) Transition to a bathroom with gray textured wall tiles. The man, now wearing a blue sports t-shirt, places the product box on a black metal shelf next to various toiletries and a hair dryer. The lighting is neutral and typical for a residential bathroom. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the shower head itself. It is made of shiny chrome and shaped exactly like a 1950s-style microphone. A hand holds the device, rotating it slightly to catch the light, revealing high reflections on the metallic surface and a black handle. (4) The man is shown from behind as he attaches the silver microphone-shaped shower head to a black flexible hose. He uses his hands to screw the parts together while standing in a modern walk-in shower stall with glass partitions and gray tiled walls. (5) A woman with long dark hair and several rings on her fingers is seen from a side profile. She holds the shower head close to her face and playfully mimics a microphone check, moving her mouth as if speaking or singing into the metallic grill. (6) The shower is turned on, and water streams out from the grill of the microphone shower head. The man holds it by the handle, observing the water flow which appears strong and steady. The background shows the wet tiles of the shower area. (7) The man is inside the shower stall, appearing shirtless with a towel visible at his waist. He grips the microphone shower head and sings with intense facial expressions and dramatic gestures. Water continues to spray onto his face and body as he performs for the camera.
